basic_info.description: Welcome to 1871 25th Avenue, a charming single-family home nestled in the Outer Sunset neighborhood. Built in 1939, this residence offers a blend of classic architecture and modern living. Encompassing 2,112 square feet of living space, this two-story home features 3 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. Situated on a 3,000 square foot lot, this property offers potential for outdoor enhancements, gardening, or entertaining spaces. There is ADU Potential in Garage. 1871 25th Ave presents a fantastic opportunity for a first time home buyer to get their foot in the door, or a contractor/developer to improve and expand it to it's full potential.
